    if line_input[pos:pos+3] == 'dot':
        print('.', end='')

    else:

            email_present = True

    print('@', end='')
    pos += 2
    if pos < length:
        print(line_input[pos], end='')
else:
    if pos < length:
        print(line_input[pos], end='')
    if pos + 1 < length:
        print(line_input[pos + 1], end='')
    if pos + 2 < length:
        print(line_input[pos + 2], end='')
